code_audit.monitoring_change: Only no_grad snapshots/readiness checks of last_tokens_per_expert are batched; reads are cloned and no training buffer or correction bias is written.
code_audit.training_bias_update: moe_load_balance.py optimizer pre-hook writes last_tokens_per_expert and e_score_correction_bias after backward; its code and registration are unchanged.
code_audit.training_loss_path: seq_wise_loss and router_z_loss are computed before monitoring. The monitor metrics are returned separately for logging.
unconfirmed_numerical_sources: The gather of hidden_states with repeated token indices requires gradient accumulation across selected experts.
Grouped weight-gradient accumulation and distributed reductions may change floating-point addition order; repeatability was not measured here.
Tiny parameter changes can change top-k expert routing. These mechanisms are hypotheses, not a proven cause of the observed step30 difference.

manifest_new_adamw_switch.reason: source_provenance copies every experiment_manifest key other than hashes into manifest_settings, including adamw_foreach; source hash differences include optimizer files.

recommendation.reason: The isolated change is read-only statistics and shows 4.14–5.58% speed reduction in each block, but the 10.50% step30 gradient-norm outlier exceeds available same-backend context.
recommendation.next_control: Repeat the original baseline for60 updates with the same seed, source, environment and data. Compare its speed and scalar divergence both to baseline_v2 and monitor; retain all results, not only the faster baseline.
recommendation.if_repeat_does_not_explain_difference: Check deterministic fixed-batch/full-gradient equality and per-layer routing or bias states on a small controlled run before asserting numerical equivalence.
recommendation.extrapolation_limit: This is simple arithmetic from a short run, not a measured epoch saving.
